status: proposed support taxonomy; not an implemented-format guarantee

categories.example_inputs: Current APIs, saved bundles and registry/area contracts
categories.usable_information: Existing IDs, original sources, geometry, candidate facts and revisions
categories.normalized_targets: Legacy adapter to entity/representation/revision/source links
categories.critical_limits: Reconcile physical IDs and registry IDs explicitly; preserve previous identifiers and references

categories.example_inputs: GeoPackage, Shapefile sets, GeoJSON, GML, feature APIs, CSV/XML registers
categories.usable_information: Parcel boundaries, administrative context, identifiers, area assertions
categories.normalized_targets: Parcel entity; recorded-boundary representation; external identifier; register assertion
categories.critical_limits: ULPIN alone supplies an identifier, not a boundary; preserve issuer, source validity and ambiguous matches

categories.example_inputs: GeoJSON, GeoPackage, Shapefile, ArcGIS feature JSON, OSM XML/PBF, database export
categories.usable_information: Outlines, names, source IDs, height attributes when meaningful
categories.normalized_targets: Building/building-part entity; observation; ground/roof/design geometry role
categories.critical_limits: A roof outline is not automatically ground occupation; unknown height stays unknown
categories.current_evidence: Several bounded 2D paths inspected; other formats are roadmap

categories.example_inputs: GIS polygons, codes, boundary schedules, reviewed manual boundaries
categories.usable_information: Ward/locality/block coverage, names, authority and dates
categories.normalized_targets: AdministrativeArea plus typed memberships; separate AuthoringArea
categories.critical_limits: Administrative hierarchy is not physical containment or ownership; coverage may overlap

categories.example_inputs: GIS line/surface layers, CAD, LandXML/IFC/OpenDRIVE profiles, survey schedules
categories.usable_information: Alignment, road surface, lanes, widths/profiles, carriageways, structures
categories.normalized_targets: TransportAsset, Alignment, Surface, NetworkNode/Edge, corridor relationship
categories.critical_limits: Centreline, physical surface and recorded road land remain separate; crossing does not prove connectivity
categories.current_evidence: Generic road features exist; richer transport schema proposed

categories.example_inputs: GIS, IFC infrastructure, CAD/alignment profiles and asset registers
categories.usable_information: Tracks, station/structure parts, elevations, sections and network connections
categories.normalized_targets: TransportAsset subtypes; alignment; supported profile geometry; topology
categories.critical_limits: Do not infer a junction at an overpass or derive track geometry from service schedules

categories.family: Water, sewer, drainage, gas and telecom assets
categories.example_inputs: GIS, CAD/as-built drawings, IFC MEP, CSV profiles and asset APIs
categories.usable_information: Pipes/ducts, nodes, dimensions, invert/crown/centre levels, material and asset IDs
categories.normalized_targets: UtilityAsset, profile/sweep representation, network connectivity and restrictions
categories.critical_limits: Depth needs a reference surface; diameter is not a restriction width; keep unknown alignment/depth distinct
categories.current_evidence: Generic utility/profile fields inspected; network model is proposed

categories.example_inputs: Utility GIS, IFC MEP, pole/cable schedules, CAD and asset registers
categories.usable_information: Cables, ducts, poles, transformer parts, circuits, ports and ratings
categories.normalized_targets: UtilityAsset subtypes; physical route vs logical circuit relations
categories.critical_limits: Electrical connectivity is not identical to geometric proximity; overhead shape may be unknown

categories.example_inputs: IFC/IFCZIP and explicit vendor-export profiles
categories.usable_information: Project/site/building/storey/space/component hierarchy, property sets, materials and geometry
categories.normalized_targets: Entity graph, source-object crosswalk, representations and typed domain extensions
categories.critical_limits: Interpret units, nested placements and map conversion; IfcSpace is not automatically a registered flat; preserve unsupported constructs
categories.current_evidence: No IFC ingestion verified in this inspection

categories.example_inputs: CityGML/CityJSON and declared encodings/versions
categories.usable_information: City objects, semantic surfaces, parts, relationships, appearances and source LOD
categories.normalized_targets: Urban entities, components, semantic representations and source-LOD metadata
categories.critical_limits: Do not equate source LOD with evidence completeness or flatten multipart objects into boxes

categories.example_inputs: DXF/DWG/DGN, PDF/vector exports; proprietary native files via supported exports
categories.usable_information: Drawing entities, layers, dimensions, blocks, sections and linework
categories.normalized_targets: Drawing asset and candidates, later reviewed geometry/quantities
categories.critical_limits: Units and layer meaning may be absent; a closed polyline need not mean a property boundary; SDK/dependency checks required

categories.example_inputs: PDF, PNG/JPEG/TIFF, SVG/CAD profiles and plan sets
categories.usable_information: Room outlines, openings, floor labels, dimensions and level references
categories.normalized_targets: Optional SourceAsset; calibrated candidates; storey/space/boundary representations
categories.critical_limits: Attachment works without extraction. Scale, geographic placement and vertical placement are separate readiness gates
categories.current_evidence: Plan/source and bounded extraction foundations inspected

categories.example_inputs: CSV/XLSX/JSON, database/API export, tabular reports
categories.usable_information: Unit labels, level bounds, areas, usage and cross-references
categories.normalized_targets: BuildingLevel/Space/SpaceGroup; observations; membership and quantity assertions
categories.critical_limits: A table does not imply room geometry; floor labels are not numeric heights; reported areas are not recomputed areas
categories.current_evidence: Strict level CSV inspected; arbitrary sheets need mapping

categories.example_inputs: GNSS processed solutions, total-station/levelling exports, CSV/LandXML/control files
categories.usable_information: Coordinates, benchmark ties, residuals, uncertainty, epoch and measurement method
categories.normalized_targets: SurveyObservation, ControlPoint, ReferenceFrame and TransformOperation
categories.critical_limits: Raw/processed data must be distinguished; a CRS name alone does not establish vertical comparability or survey quality
categories.current_evidence: Basic control/placement contracts exist, richer survey metadata proposed

categories.example_inputs: RINEX and authorized station/correction products
categories.usable_information: Observation/navigation time series, station and antenna metadata
categories.normalized_targets: Immutable raw assets plus later processed survey solutions and derivation record
categories.critical_limits: Do not draw parcel boundaries directly from raw observations; specialized processing and quality review required

categories.example_inputs: LAS/LAZ, supported point-cloud packages, E57/PLY/XYZ profiles
categories.usable_information: Point positions, classification, intensity, returns, time and optional colour
categories.normalized_targets: PointCloud asset, spatial index/metadata; separately derived terrain/building candidates
categories.critical_limits: No point-per-row requirement; sensor sampling and occlusion do not prove interiors, ownership or complete watertight solids

categories.example_inputs: DEM/DTM/DSM GeoTIFF and other declared raster/terrain/TIN profiles
categories.usable_information: Ground/top-surface/bathymetric elevations, resolution, grid, no-data and dates
categories.normalized_targets: CoverageAsset and SurfaceModel with explicit surface meaning and reference
categories.critical_limits: Do not silently use top-of-roof DSM as bare ground; vertical datum, gaps and resolution are mandatory metadata

categories.example_inputs: Orthophotos, georeferenced rasters, drone images, calibrated cameras, generated meshes
categories.usable_information: Image context; measurement-ready products only after supported alignment/reconstruction
categories.normalized_targets: Raster/Photo/Mesh assets; camera model; control ties; extraction derivations
categories.critical_limits: An ordinary screenshot is not a georeferenced survey; preserve acquisition date, resolution and processing lineage
categories.current_evidence: Simple photo attachments exist; photogrammetry not verified

categories.example_inputs: glTF/GLB, OBJ/FBX/export profiles, licensed 3D Tiles
categories.usable_information: Appearance meshes, textures, placement, sometimes feature metadata
categories.normalized_targets: VisualRepresentation/SceneAsset and explicit canonical-ID mapping
categories.critical_limits: A visually rich mesh may have no interiors, usable semantic IDs, watertight solid or measurement suitability
categories.delivery_phase: First GLB binding; other profiles later

categories.example_inputs: Authorized register/API/database exports, CSV/XML/JSON and deed/document scans
categories.usable_information: External identifiers, recorded parties, rights/restrictions, dates, shares and textual extents
categories.normalized_targets: RegisterRecord, LegalSpatialUnit, RRR assertion, external IDs and optional source links
categories.critical_limits: Record metadata without geometry remains searchable but unplaced; a document scan or importer is not legal adjudication
categories.current_evidence: Registry/identifier scaffolding inspected; full legal model proposed

categories.example_inputs: Authorized CSV/API/property-management export, reviewed forms and optional agreements
categories.usable_information: Party identities, time-bounded occupancy/tenancy and organization roles
categories.normalized_targets: Restricted Party/Occupancy/RRR relationships, separate from AppAccount
categories.critical_limits: Living in a flat, owning it and logging into the app are distinct. Do not put PII or agreement URLs in public tiles
categories.current_evidence: Current rights use party strings; normalized private model proposed

categories.family: Water bodies, vegetation, terrain use and context
categories.example_inputs: GIS, classified imagery, field inventories, ecological/asset datasets
categories.usable_information: Surface extents, vegetation/land cover and time-specific water levels
categories.normalized_targets: WaterBody/Vegetation/LandCover entities; appropriate surface representations
categories.critical_limits: A shoreline, bed, flood envelope and measured water level are different representations
categories.current_evidence: Generic public-land kind insufficient for full semantics

categories.family: Web services and continuously delivered datasets
categories.example_inputs: OGC API Features/WFS, ArcGIS services, WMS/WMTS, authorized object catalogs and APIs
categories.usable_information: Feature pages, raster images, coverage descriptions, provenance and update tokens
categories.normalized_targets: DatasetRevision/SourceAsset snapshots or permitted external references, then domain adapters
categories.critical_limits: Protocol is not a domain type; WMS images are not raw features; handle paging, rate limits, rights and incomplete acquisitions

categories.example_inputs: Forms, tracing, measured edits, model proposals and canonical fixtures
categories.usable_information: Explicit user-authored or inferred candidates and scenario parameters
categories.normalized_targets: Observation, CandidateRevision, Decision, Derivation and scenario-scoped entities
categories.critical_limits: AI output cannot self-approve; preserve source locators and operator/model versions; synthetic alternatives must not contaminate observed world
categories.current_evidence: Candidate fact and world-status concepts inspected

categories.example_inputs: Time-series APIs/files for asset state, level, status or monitoring
categories.usable_information: Timestamped observed-property values tied to features or locations
categories.normalized_targets: ObservationSeries asset plus indexed metadata and current-value view
categories.critical_limits: Not every observation revises the static building mesh; separate sampling quality from cadastral evidence
